story.title: Fiery crash in Arlington after driver allegedly flees from police, officials say
story.summary: A high-speed incident on Highway 360 in Arlington ends in a fiery crash, sending one driver to the hospital on Sunday. November 22, 2026 / 7:52 PM CST / CBS Texas A high-speed incident on Highway 360 in Arlington ends in a fiery crash, sending one driver to the hospital on Sunday with serious injuries. The Arlington Police Department said officers were conducting speed enforcement along Hwy. 360 around 3:30 p.m. when they clocked a Chevrolet Malibu traveling nearly 90 miles per hour in a posted 60 mph zone. Officers activated their emergency lights and sirens and attempted to pull over the driver; however, the driver did not stop and began making dangerous lane changes, police said. The officers ultimately decided not to pursue the Malibu and turned off their emergency equipment.
